channel.title: Pier & Point · Coming up
channel.description: Coming up changes and milestones, for four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront. Every item names its source.

item.title: Expected · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: Expected, not scheduled: the project is expected to open for use in 2029, subject to funding. The month differs by source: June 2029 (SFCTA's April 28, 2026 post, "seeking construction funding to implement the project by June 2029", and the April 14 presentation, "Open for use expected June 2029"), December 2029 (SFCTA's April 14 packet, project description: "have the project open for use by December 2029, subject to funding availability"; its allocation form lists "Open for Use" in April-June 2029) and "project completion by the end of 2029" (The Voice of San Francisco, October 6, 2026). Construction was not yet funded in April 2026; the FTA announced a $14.1 million award in September 2026, but no source gives a construction schedule. (~2029)

item.title: Expected · 409/499 Illinois Street: Early construction work is under way and the main renovation of 409 Illinois St is expected to begin in 2026: 261,117 gross sq ft to be converted into a new home for UCSF's School of Dentistry and a shared education center for students in dentistry, medicine, nursing, pharmacy and physical therapy (UC's project title: Mission Bay Education Center and Dental Clinics). American School & University (2026-09-08) says "renovation work expected to begin in 2026" and "Early construction activities are underway" while final design is completed; Suffolk (contractor) and CO Architects (architect) were selected via progressive design-build (Construction Dive, published September 1, 2026, citing an August 27 announcement). No source read dates the start of the main renovation; the under-construction status rests on the early work. (~2026)

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel C1: Port staff and the developer expect to bring proposed amendments to the DDA and related transaction documents to the Port Commission and Board of Supervisors 'by the end of this year or early next year' (staff report dated Aug 7, 2026, p.2 and p.6); the Aug 11, 2026 minutes (p.7) say staff and Brookfield 'expect to return with proposed amendments in late 2026 or early 2027'. December 2026 is the early end of that range and no hearing date is given in either source; the same report also proposes extending the term of the DDA, Development Agreement and Master Lease by 5 years (~2026)

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel C1: The DDA's Schedule of Performance sets outside dates for each phase's horizontal improvements (streets, utilities and parks), not for completing the buildings on its parcels; for Phase 2 it is 16 years after Project approval, and Pier & Point's arithmetic from 2017 gives about 2033 (the Port's report states no calendar year). No source read says C1A, C1B or C1C is a Phase 2 parcel: Port Item 11A places the affordable parcel C1B in Phase 3, and the Port's proposed 2026 phasing plan groups the C1 parcels with Parcel K South in subphase 2B. Not a forecast for this parcel (~2033)
